scripts.db:down: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f compose.yaml down; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose -f compose.yaml down; else echo 'Docker CLI not found.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.db:reset: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f compose.yaml down -v; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose -f compose.yaml down -v; fi && bash scripts/dev-compose-up.sh all
scripts.db:logs: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f compose.yaml logs -f; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose -f compose.yaml logs -f; fi
scripts.ci:validate: echo 'No build/test commands yet — spike scaffold pending' && docker compose -f compose.yaml config --quiet && echo 'compose.yaml valid'
